generatorMustNot: Do not invent prices, hours, services, reviews, or testimonials.
Do not set factStatus to owner_approved or bypass the owner-approval gate.
Photo links are reference only and were not downloaded. Do not display them until the owner approves that use.
Keep the text "Internal concept, not endorsed by the business" and noindex on any internal concept.
Do not publish hours until the owner picks one schedule. Do not use the Lowell phone on the Brighton page.
Do not invent a prepared-food menu or publish Apple Maps amenities as owner features.
Do not reuse homepage quotes or the Google review widget as testimonials.
Do not describe the market as unlicensed because the food-establishment file has no row at this address.
